correctness.rationale: PASS: For the autonomous polynomial system xdot=(h-z)y-nu1*x, ydot=(h+z)x-nu2*y, zdot=xy-z with h,nu1,nu2>0 and compactly supported invariant probability mu, test the invariant flow generator against antiderivatives of arbitrary functions of a single coordinate. This proves E[xy|z]=z, E[y(h-z)|x]=nu1*x, E[x(h+z)|y]=nu2*y with the correct conditional measures. Stationarity of (x²+y²)/2, (x²-y²)/2, z²/2 yields nu1 E[x²]=hm-E[z²] and nu2 E[y²]=hm+E[z²], hence Var(z)+nu1 E[x²]=m(h-m). If E[x²]=0, x identically zero on the invariant support; global bounded complete orbits force y=z=0. Therefore any non-origin compact invariant probability has 0<m<h and positive mass in 0<z<h. The speed-defect variance identities are orthogonal-regression Pythagoras identities. No ergodicity, chaotic-attractor existence, or boundary-exit assumption is used.
